levels.surface: أبو جعفر محمد ابن علي بن الحسين بن موسى بن بابويه القمي

notes: The last route speaker «أبيه» tells his own visit to the Fadl («قال: دخلت على الفضل بن الربيع»): a first-person narrator named only by relation (rule 11).
Musa b. Ja'far and Fadl speak inside the account; they are in the scene and the saying is the eyewitness's account, so they are not added as links (rule 6).
«الشيخ الفقيه» is a title, left out; «(رضي الله عنه)» and «(4)» are glosses and footnote marks.
